## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete change and its downstream impact.

## Scope and authority

- Task Packet / plan:
- Base / head / frozen patch digest:

## Validation and independent review

- Actual commands and exit codes:

## Human decision

- [ ] Existing enforced branch/check/ownership controls were verified separately.
- [ ] A human has reviewed the change before merge; release is a separate decision.
- [ ] No downstream automatic application or governance auto-merge is introduced.
